Opened by ops-lukas on 2026-09-03

If an export fails (for example the server returns an error), the Export button
stays greyed out and I can't click it again until I reload the whole page.

args.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Change the ExportButton component to clear the busy state in the failure path of the exportReport call. This lets the button become clickable again after a failed export, instead of staying greyed out until the page is reloaded. The error currently causes the busy state to stay true because only the success path clears it.
